M-BIND-REF.Purpose: Ephemeral binding: subscribe to events on the behavior instance currently occupying a property slot, releasing when the binding is torn down.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: BindRef: acquire handler subscription on the current slot behavior.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Following behavior replacement — owned by M-WATCH-REF.

Requirements.REQ-001: A BindRef never resubscribes on slot change; a replaced behavior's subscription is released with the binding.
Requirements.REQ-002: BindRef attaches a strong handler independent of owner type; it unsubscribes on slot Changing or explicit owner cleanup via BehaviorRegistry.

Inputs.IN-001: slot: IPropertyRef — the property slot to bind to.
Inputs.IN-002: handler: Delegate — event handler attached to the current behavior.

Outputs.OUT-001: subscription registered in the registry under the binding owner.

M-BIND-REF.Codemap: * `BindRef` : `IPropertyRef` ref struct * `BindRef(propertyRef)` -> slot `Behavior` events * `BindRef.{OnUpdate|OnActivate|OnStart|OnComplete|OnReset}` * `BindRef` -> `BehaviorRegistry.RegisterSubscription` / `UnregisterSubscription` * `BindRef` != `WatchRef` : slot change
